name: typo3-mcp-connector
description: Connects Claude Desktop to a TYPO3 site running EXT:mcp_server.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the TYPO3 MCP server. Enter the TYPO3 URL and an OAuth token in the extension settings. Create the token in the TYPO3 backend under User > MCP Server.

server_url.title: TYPO3 URL
server_url.description: Address of the TYPO3 site, e.g. https://dev.example.com. /mcp is added automatically.

token.title: OAuth token
token.description: Personal token from the TYPO3 backend: User > MCP Server > Active OAuth Tokens.
